purpose: Test a concrete time-and-motion theoryization: an activity begins Pending and finishes Done, while the theoryization uses the Cubical dimension I as the whole activity parameter and represents the discrete completion observation by an internal I-indexed term. Search for the exact extra coherence obligation and check it natively.

source_basis.kind: AI-proposed L3 task after full four-set cognition, grounded in the user's time-versus-temporal-order clarification
references: 从抽象到悖论——HoTT研究的核心问题意识与思想展开/002 - 前提改变、结果与时间.md
/Volumes/D/HoTT独立答复/HoTT非现实性悖论机器统观完整方案/005 - 六条研究线与首轮实验.md

answer_visibility.limitation: The designing AI knew the conceptual experiment. This tests configuration independence of the frozen engine, not training-data novelty or human/AI blindness.

input.type_ref: an activity with exact boundary stages start/finish and a discrete Bool completion observation
input.available_information: the two endpoint observations and the explicitly chosen theoryization; no dense order, metric, physical clock or hidden midpoint is supplied

environment.reality_model: the finite Stage control in L3MotionSupport: phase start = false and phase finish = true
environment.theory_model: an internal dimension-indexed term f : I → A, whose abstraction λ i → f i is a Path between endpoint values
environment.arrival_policy: only the start and finish boundary observations are fixed

observation.value: exact discrete completion phase at the two boundary stages
observation.trace: the interior trace is not observed or assumed dense

time_structure.reality: two operational stages with a permitted discontinuous Bool phase change
time_structure.theory: Cubical dimension abstraction, which supplies endpoint Path coherence for every I-indexed term
time_structure.temporal_order: start precedes finish in the operational control; no general order is asserted for I

completion.criterion_ref: the activity is Pending at start and Done at finish; both boundary values must remain exactly distinguishable

quantifiers.instances: all A : Type₀ and all internal f : I → A satisfying the declared endpoint-apartness premise
quantifiers.realization: symbolic theorem target checked by native Cubical Agda

allowed_resources: declared symbolic rules to depth 4 followed by native Cubical Agda checking
prohibited_extra_information: no replacement of Bool by a path-connected phase type; no discontinuity primitive added after search; no identification of I with a dense ordered real line or physical time
assumptions: the I-indexed representation is the explicit theoryization being tested, not a requirement imposed by every HoTT or Cubical model
the primitive dimension I has its own IUniv sort and is not treated as an ordinary Type-valued physical time object
the operational Stage control is a model-level reality counterpart, not an empirical theorem about spacetime
obligations: the symbolic search must derive the candidate from declared typed rules and must lose it when the interval-eta rule is ablated
the native target must quantify over A : Type₀ rather than enumerate a finite set of A values
a genuine path-valued Segment control and a discrete Stage completion control must type-check
the same path-abstraction move applied to an ordinary Stage index must be rejected by the native kernel
the result remains an exploration candidate until a standard-use and reality bridge is independently established

known_positive_controls.description: Stage-indexed phase changes exactly from false to true and the endpoints are distinguishable
a genuine Type with a path constructor supports endpoint path motion

known_negative_controls.description: the path-abstraction proof shape must fail when f is indexed by ordinary Stage rather than I

correspondence.original_activity: one exact transition from Pending at start to Done at finish
theoryization_steps: use the Cubical dimension I as the activity parameter
represent the discrete completion observation by an internal I-indexed term
changed_fields: the operational two-stage carrier is replaced by Cubical dimension abstraction
correspondence.observation_justification: Pending versus Done is the original activity's exact completion criterion, declared before symbolic search
open_obligations: determine whether any standard or natural HoTT use actually makes this activity-time identification
compare with explicit event/discontinuity structures without changing the original endpoint task
physical correspondence and originality are not assessed by this run
